req.title: Task id is auto-generated
req.statement: The system shall assign a unique integer id to each new task; client-supplied ids in the payload shall be ignored.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should auto-generate a unique integer ID for each new task, ignoring any client-supplied IDs. This behavior needs to be validated through positive, negative, and boundary test cases to ensure robustness against common mutations.

tests.name: test_create_task_auto_id_positive
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with valid data.
expected: The response contains a task with a unique auto-generated ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "Test task description", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert "id" in response_data
assert isinstance(response_data["id"], int)
assert response_data["title"] == "New Task"
assert response_data["description"] == "Test task description"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_with_client_id_negative
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with a client-supplied ID.
expected: The response contains a task with a unique auto-generated ID, ignoring the client-supplied ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"id": 999, "title": "Task with Client ID", "description": "Should ignore client ID", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert "id" in response_data
assert response_data["id"] != 999
assert response_data["title"] == "Task with Client ID"
assert response_data["description"] == "Should ignore client ID"
assert response_data["completed"] is False

tests.name: test_create_task_boundary_title_length
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to create a new task with a title at the maximum allowed length.
expected: The response contains a task with the specified title and a unique auto-generated ID.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

max_length_title = "X" * 100
response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": max_length_title, "description": "Boundary test for title length", "completed": false}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
response_data = response.json()
assert "id" in response_data
assert response_data["title"] == max_length_title
assert response_data["description"] == "Boundary test for title length"
assert response_data["completed"] is False
